description: MultiHazard is an R package for estimating the joint occurrence of co-occurring hazards. Its README and JOSS-linked documentation describe missing-value handling, detrending, declustering, lagged correlation analysis, conditional sampling, copula methods and probability contours. Users supply multivariate hazard time series; outputs include design-event ensembles, return-level contours and likelihood summaries. Geographic coverage follows the observation stations and hazards supplied by a modeller. GitHub metadata and the README state GPL-3.0 licensing. A limitation is that stationary multivariate assumptions and dependence-model choices need testing against changing climate and short records; no fitted result was reproduced here. The package can construct compound flood, wind or heat events for stress-testing infrastructure systems. Its statistical modelling differs from the catalogue's ERA5 source fields, which can serve as one possible input after appropriate bias and dependence checks. No hazard series or R package archive was downloaded.
inputs: Multivariate hazard observations and model settings
